test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Justice _______ was appointed Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of India with effect from 24th April 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nuthalapati Venkata Ramana.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice ****Nuthalapati Venkata Ramana** was appointed **Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of India** with effect from 24th April 2021.
 
• The Chief Justice of India is appointed by the president of India after consultation with the judges of the Supreme Court and high courts.
 
 
• Justice Nuthalapati Venkata Ramana has been appointed as the 48th Chief Justice of India (CJI).
 
• He is also the former **Chief Justice of Delhi High Court** and acting **Chief Justice of Andhra Pradesh High Court.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **The current and 50th Chief Justice is Justice Dhananjaya Y. Chandrachud, who entered office on 9 November 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• At present, the Supreme Court consists of **34 judges** (one chief justice and thirty-three other judges).

 
 
• The judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President.
 
 
 
• The President of India is the head of the Indian State.
 
 
• He is a part of the Union Executive (Article 52-78) along with the Vice-President, Prime Minister, Council of Ministers, and Attorney-General of India.
